recipes.title: Overnight Oats with Blueberries
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds and honey together in a jar or bowl.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or overnight.
Stir well in the morning and loosen with a splash of milk if it is too thick.
Top with the blueberries and serve cold.

recipes.title: Spinach & Tomato Scramble on Toast
steps: Halve the cherry tomatoes and beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the spinach and stir until just wilted, about 1 minute.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently until softly set, 2 to 3 minutes. Crumble in the feta.
Toast the bread and pile the scramble on top.

recipes.title: Banana Pancakes
steps: Whisk the flour and baking powder in a large bowl.
Mash one banana in a second bowl, then whisk in the milk, egg and 1 tbsp melted butter.
Pour the wet mix into the dry and stir until just combined. A few lumps are fine.
Heat a pan over medium heat with a little butter. Pour in 1/4 cup batter per pancake.
Cook until bubbles form on top, about 2 minutes, then flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Slice the other banana and serve the pancakes with the banana and maple syrup.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Wraps
steps: Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Cook the chicken 5 to 6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Shred the romaine and shave the parmesan.
Toss the lettuce and chicken with the dressing.
Divide between the tortillas, add the parmesan, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.

recipes.title: Creamy Tomato Basil Soup
steps: Dice the onion and mince the garlic.
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion for 6 to 8 minutes until soft. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and stock. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 20 minutes.
Add most of the basil and blend until smooth with an immersion blender.
Stir in the cream, season to taste and serve topped with the remaining basil.

recipes.title: Chickpea & Feta Salad Bowl
steps: Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Dice the cucumber and red onion and halve the tomatoes.
Whisk the olive oil with the juice of the lemon, salt and pepper.
Combine everything in a bowl and toss with the dressing.
Crumble the feta on top and serve right away, or chill for up to a day.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Finely chop the onion and carrot and mince the garlic.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Cook the onion and carrot for 8 minutes until soft. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the beef, breaking it up, and cook until browned, about 8 minutes.
Stir in the tomatoes, season and simmer on low for 30 to 40 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente. Drain, reserving a little pasta water.
Toss the pasta with the sauce, loosening with pasta water if needed. Serve with grated parmesan.

recipes.title: Chicken & Broccoli Stir-fry
steps: Start the rice: rinse it, then cook with 3 cups of water, covered, for 15 minutes.
Slice the chicken thinly. Cut the broccoli into florets and slice the peppers. Mince the garlic and ginger.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Stir-fry the chicken for 5 minutes until cooked, then set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli and peppers for 4 minutes. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the chicken, add the soy sauce and a splash of water, and toss for 1 minute.
Serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Lemon Baked Salmon with Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F). Halve the potatoes and toss with half the oil, salt and pepper on a baking tray.
Roast the potatoes for 15 minutes.
Cut the broccoli into florets. Add to the tray with the salmon, drizzle with the remaining oil and top the salmon with lemon slices.
Roast for 12 to 15 minutes until the salmon flakes easily.
Squeeze over the remaining lemon juice and serve.

recipes.title: Black Bean Tacos
steps: Drain the beans and warm them in a pan with the cumin, a splash of water and salt for 5 minutes. Mash lightly.
Dice the tomatoes and onion and mix with the juice of one lime.
Mash the avocados with the juice of the other lime and a pinch of salt. Grate the cheddar.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan, 30 seconds per side.
Fill each tortilla with beans, avocado, tomato salsa and cheese.

recipes.title: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Warm the stock in a saucepan and keep it at a gentle simmer.
Slice the mushrooms. Cook them in the oil in a wide pan over high heat until golden, about 6 minutes. Set aside.
Lower the heat, melt 1 tbsp butter and cook the diced onion for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and rice and stir for 2 minutes.
Add the stock one ladle at a time, stirring until each is absorbed. This takes about 20 minutes.
When the rice is creamy and tender, stir in the mushrooms, the remaining butter and the grated parmesan.
Rest for 2 minutes, season and serve.

recipes.title: Red Lentil Coconut Curry
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet and keep it warm.
Sauté the diced onion in a little oil for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and stir for 1 minute.
Add the rinsed lentils, tomatoes, coconut milk and 1 cup of water.
Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils are soft and the sauce is thick.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and season with salt.
Serve over the rice.

Your Recipes note is now a recipe and meal planning app. I tried it only on generic sample data, not your seeded recipes, because trying the app on your real data is switched off. The seed data is saved in the note's app. I haven't seen your twelve recipes or this week's plan on screen.

On the sample data I opened a recipe, scaled the servings, started cooking mode, opened the plan and opened its recipe picker. All of that worked. The shopping list showed only the two extra items I seeded, because the sample has no plan. So I haven't seen it add up ingredients across recipes.

- **Recipes:**
  - Each recipe has ingredients (amount, unit, aisle), steps, servings, time and tags.
  - You can add, edit and delete recipes. Delete needs a second tap to confirm.
  - The servings stepper on a recipe scales every ingredient, including fractions like ½ and ¼.
  - Search covers titles, ingredients and tags. Tag chips filter the list.
- **Plan:**
  - A week view with breakfast, lunch and dinner on each day.
  - You can step between weeks.
  - You can change servings for each meal.
  - A recipe's "Add to plan" button puts it on a day this week.
- **Shopping:**
  - It sums ingredients across the week's plan, scaled to the servings you planned.
  - Items are grouped by aisle and can be ticked off.
  - You can add your own items. I seeded two: dish soap and coffee beans.
  - "Clear checked" removes ticked items.
- **Cooking mode:**
  - It shows one step at a time in large type, with Back and Next buttons and a progress bar.
  - You can switch to the ingredients, scaled to your servings.
  - It asks the device to keep the screen on, and the arrow keys work on a Mac.
- **Seed data:** Twelve recipes (3 breakfasts, 3 lunches, 6 dinners) and a plan for Oct 5–11, with the two extra shopping items.

The recipes share some ingredients, such as onions, olive oil and canned tomatoes, so you should see totals combine when you open the shopping list. Items only combine when the unit matches, so "2 cups" and "300 g" of the same thing stay separate lines.

I also removed the template's Home and Settings screens, so the app has three tabs: Recipes, Plan and Shopping.

recipes.title: Overnight Oats with Blueberries
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds and honey together in a jar or bowl.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or overnight.
Stir well in the morning and loosen with a splash of milk if it is too thick.
Top with the blueberries and serve cold.

recipes.title: Spinach & Tomato Scramble on Toast
steps: Halve the cherry tomatoes and beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the spinach and stir until just wilted, about 1 minute.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently until softly set, 2 to 3 minutes. Crumble in the feta.
Toast the bread and pile the scramble on top.

recipes.title: Banana Pancakes
steps: Whisk the flour and baking powder in a large bowl.
Mash one banana in a second bowl, then whisk in the milk, egg and 1 tbsp melted butter.
Pour the wet mix into the dry and stir until just combined. A few lumps are fine.
Heat a pan over medium heat with a little butter. Pour in 1/4 cup batter per pancake.
Cook until bubbles form on top, about 2 minutes, then flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Slice the other banana and serve the pancakes with the banana and maple syrup.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Wraps
steps: Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Cook the chicken 5 to 6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Shred the romaine and shave the parmesan.
Toss the lettuce and chicken with the dressing.
Divide between the tortillas, add the parmesan, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.

recipes.title: Creamy Tomato Basil Soup
steps: Dice the onion and mince the garlic.
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion for 6 to 8 minutes until soft. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and stock. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 20 minutes.
Add most of the basil and blend until smooth with an immersion blender.
Stir in the cream, season to taste and serve topped with the remaining basil.

recipes.title: Chickpea & Feta Salad Bowl
steps: Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Dice the cucumber and red onion and halve the tomatoes.
Whisk the olive oil with the juice of the lemon, salt and pepper.
Combine everything in a bowl and toss with the dressing.
Crumble the feta on top and serve right away, or chill for up to a day.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Finely chop the onion and carrot and mince the garlic.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Cook the onion and carrot for 8 minutes until soft. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the beef, breaking it up, and cook until browned, about 8 minutes.
Stir in the tomatoes, season and simmer on low for 30 to 40 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente. Drain, reserving a little pasta water.
Toss the pasta with the sauce, loosening with pasta water if needed. Serve with grated parmesan.

recipes.title: Chicken & Broccoli Stir-fry
steps: Start the rice: rinse it, then cook with 3 cups of water, covered, for 15 minutes.
Slice the chicken thinly. Cut the broccoli into florets and slice the peppers. Mince the garlic and ginger.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Stir-fry the chicken for 5 minutes until cooked, then set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli and peppers for 4 minutes. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the chicken, add the soy sauce and a splash of water, and toss for 1 minute.
Serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Lemon Baked Salmon with Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F). Halve the potatoes and toss with half the oil, salt and pepper on a baking tray.
Roast the potatoes for 15 minutes.
Cut the broccoli into florets. Add to the tray with the salmon, drizzle with the remaining oil and top the salmon with lemon slices.
Roast for 12 to 15 minutes until the salmon flakes easily.
Squeeze over the remaining lemon juice and serve.

recipes.title: Black Bean Tacos
steps: Drain the beans and warm them in a pan with the cumin, a splash of water and salt for 5 minutes. Mash lightly.
Dice the tomatoes and onion and mix with the juice of one lime.
Mash the avocados with the juice of the other lime and a pinch of salt. Grate the cheddar.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan, 30 seconds per side.
Fill each tortilla with beans, avocado, tomato salsa and cheese.

recipes.title: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Warm the stock in a saucepan and keep it at a gentle simmer.
Slice the mushrooms. Cook them in the oil in a wide pan over high heat until golden, about 6 minutes. Set aside.
Lower the heat, melt 1 tbsp butter and cook the diced onion for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and rice and stir for 2 minutes.
Add the stock one ladle at a time, stirring until each is absorbed. This takes about 20 minutes.
When the rice is creamy and tender, stir in the mushrooms, the remaining butter and the grated parmesan.
Rest for 2 minutes, season and serve.

recipes.title: Red Lentil Coconut Curry
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet and keep it warm.
Sauté the diced onion in a little oil for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and stir for 1 minute.
Add the rinsed lentils, tomatoes, coconut milk and 1 cup of water.
Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils are soft and the sauce is thick.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and season with salt.
Serve over the rice.
